scope: Exact installed CJS versions and declared boundary domains; re-admission required before tracing. React descriptors do not imply renderer or lifecycle coverage.

scope.description: Finite primitive, plain object, array and function values as data, including missing arguments and additional plain arguments. Compare complete returned values and exact input identities. No supplied function is granted invocation capability. Function properties, proxies, getters and outside writes are excluded.

Finite primitive, plain object, array and function values as data, including missing arguments and additional plain arguments. Compare complete returned values and exact input identities. No supplied function is granted invocation capability. Function properties, proxies, getters and outside writes are excluded.

One finite primitive, plain object, array or function value. Observe the created function across repeated calls with changed plain arguments and receivers, and interleave independent instances. Input functions are data and must retain their exact identity without invocation. Function properties, proxies, getters, hidden comparisons against the returned library closure, and outside writes are excluded.

A supplied predicate function with no custom properties, or finite primitive/plain-data non-function inputs. Invoke the returned function repeatedly with finite argument lists including 0, 1, 2, 3 and more arguments; use plain-object, undefined and null receivers. Predicate results include all primitive truthiness classes and object/function values; include throws, repeated calls and distinct instances. Preserve actual argument identities. Excludes primitive receiver boxing, returned-function properties, proxies, getters and external callback-identity comparisons.

Input children may be null, undefined, booleans, strings, numbers (including NaN and signed zero), bigint, symbols, functions, finite acyclic arrays (including holes), or ordinary React element/fragment/portal data with scalar keys. Observe count or the complete forEach callback argument/index/receiver sequence, return identity and throws. Iterator/thenable/lazy protocols, library-read getters, nonprimitive key coercion, symbol keys, owner Fiber graphs, aliased callback arguments and input mutations require separate evidence. Unaccessed element warning descriptors remain opaque.

Input children may be null, undefined, booleans, strings, numbers (including NaN and signed zero), bigint, symbols, functions, finite acyclic arrays (including holes), or ordinary React element/fragment/portal data with scalar keys. Observe count or the complete forEach callback argument/index/receiver sequence, return identity and throws. Iterator/thenable/lazy protocols, library-read getters, nonprimitive key coercion, symbol keys, owner Fiber graphs, aliased callback arguments and input mutations require separate evidence. Unaccessed element warning descriptors remain opaque.

A factory returning an ordinary object with directly invoked own methods accessor, display and group. Preserve the original object/method identities, accessor function identity without invoking it, fresh spread results and exact pass-through column identities. Accessor inputs are functions or ordinary primitive keys; column definitions are plain enumerable string-keyed own-data objects or nullish. Excludes getters, symbols, reserved prototype keys, extracted method calls and uninstrumented consumers.

A truthy/falsy ordinary value or callback, followed by an array of plain callback parameters. Observe exact spread arguments, callback receiver/count, returned identity and original throws; non-callable values are coerced to boolean without invoking callbacks. No callback-producing results or arbitrary accessors/proxies.

Finite acyclic forests of ordinary own-data nodes in plain arrays, including empty and sparse arrays. A getChildren callback returns null, undefined or another such array. Check node/reference order, callback count/arguments/receiver, shared nodes, and callback throws. Array accessors, inherited elements, cycles and host-state mutation are outside the domain.

A result callback and optional custom argument-comparison callback. Invoke the returned function with finite primitive/plain-data arguments, changed lengths, repeated values, NaN, signed zeros, changed receivers, returns and throws, and interleaved instances. Include custom comparator truthiness, arguments, receiver, and failure recovery. Custom properties of the returned function are excluded.
